action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D NumPy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be nonpositive)")

    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=np.float64)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)          # shape (future_horizon,)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum          # shape (future_horizon,)
    # Broadcast over candidates
    weights = np.broadcast_to(normalized_weights, (n_candidates, future_horizon))

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    loss_plus = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Filtering threshold (T04)
    margin = loss_minus - loss_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
